source.name: dakota
source.docs: Utah's parity target: GNOME OS built with BuildStream on gnome-build-meta and freedesktop-sdk. The element snapshot (config/dakota-elements.tsv) is the SBOM of this revision's publish run, joined with file ownership measured in the image below.

bluefin/fedora-shim.bst.reason: Fedora's signed shim feeding Dakota's systemd-boot chain; Utah boots bootupd's shim+grub

bluefin/fprintd-fingerprint-auth.bst.reason: written for freedesktop-sdk's authselect-free PAM stack; authselect-libs owns both paths and Utah selects with-fingerprint

bluefin/fprintd-system-auth.bst.reason: written for freedesktop-sdk's authselect-free PAM stack; authselect-libs owns both paths and Utah selects with-fingerprint

bluefin/ghostty.bst.reason: native Ghostty as the only terminal; Fedora has no recipe, so adopting it means a new spec

bluefin/intel-media-driver.bst.reason: re-lays out the freedesktop-sdk VA-API extension (mapped separately); Fedora installs to the default paths

bluefin/kanata.bst.reason: Dakota remaps keys with kanata; Utah ships input-remapper until the issue decides

bluefin/kexec-disable.bst.reason: disables kexec as part of the lockdown boot chain

bluefin/libvirt.bst.reason: libvirt is installed and preset-disabled in Dakota; ujust turns it on

bluefin/lockdown-kargs.bst.reason: kernel lockdown kargs that go with the signed boot chain

bluefin/migrate-var-home-passwd.bst.reason: rewrites /var/home in passwd after the bind-mount move

bluefin/networkmanager-polkit.bst.reason: NetworkManager owns the path, with the same rule

bluefin/plymouth-bluefin-theme.bst.reason: plymouth owns plymouthd.defaults; boot branding is Utah's

bluefin/qemu-guest-agent.bst.reason: QEMU guest agent copied out of the qemu build

bluefin/secure-boot-tools-files.bst.reason: dakota-secure-boot enrolment tooling for the signed boot chain

bluefin/shell-extensions/disable-ext-val.reason: Utah ships its own extension-validation override

bluefin/signed-efi.bst.reason: systemd-boot binaries signed with the Dakota Secure Boot key

bluefin/signed-modules.bst.reason: kernel and modules signed with the Dakota Secure Boot key

bluefin/uutils-coreutils.bst.reason: uutils over the GNU coreutils names: uutils-coreutils-replace replaces coreutils-single; env from gnu-env

bluefin/wallpaper-month.bst.reason: pairs with Dakota's edit of common's gschema override; Utah ships common unedited

core/mesa-default.bst.reason: re-lays out the freedesktop-sdk Mesa extension; Fedora installs to the default paths

freedesktop-sdk.bst:components/apparmor..reason: Dakota confines with AppArmor; Utah inherits SELinux from Hummingbird

freedesktop-sdk.bst:components/buildstre.reason: BuildStream itself, shipped for GNOME OS developer tooling

freedesktop-sdk.bst:components/fdsdk-lic.reason: freedesktop-sdk build step that deduplicates license files

freedesktop-sdk.bst:components/genpeimg..reason: PE image tooling for the signed systemd-boot chain

freedesktop-sdk.bst:integration/ldconfig.reason: BuildStream integration command; RPM scriptlets and file triggers run ldconfig

gnome-build-meta.bst:core-deps/oo7-daemo.reason: oo7 is Dakota's Secret Service; Utah runs gnome-keyring

gnome-build-meta.bst:gnomeos-deps/debugi.reason: debuginfod.gnome.org serves GNOME OS builds, not Utah's RPMs

gnome-build-meta.bst:gnomeos-deps/disabl.reason: preset that contradicts Utah/Hummingbird presets by sort order

gnome-build-meta.bst:gnomeos-deps/flathu.reason: Flathub's descriptor, not gnome-build-meta's; Utah pins its own

gnome-build-meta.bst:gnomeos-deps/kmscon.reason: GNOME OS replaces the kernel VT with kmscon; not decided for Utah

gnome-build-meta.bst:gnomeos-deps/ld-con.reason: ld.so.conf for GNOME OS; glibc owns it on Fedora

gnome-build-meta.bst:gnomeos-deps/pcrloc.reason: systemd-pcrlock policy for the measured systemd-boot chain

gnome-build-meta.bst:gnomeos-deps/preset.reason: GNOME OS first-boot preset-all: the enable-by-default service policy

gnome-build-meta.bst:gnomeos-deps/snapd..reason: GNOME OS ships snapd; not decided for Utah

gnome-build-meta.bst:gnomeos-deps/sysupd.reason: systemd-sysupdate transfers for GNOME OS updates; Utah updates with bootc

gnome-build-meta.bst:gnomeos/ldconfig-al.reason: GNOME OS boot-time ldconfig for an image without package scriptlets

gnome-build-meta.bst:oci/initramfs/image.reason: initramfs built by BuildStream; a bootc image regenerates its own with dracut

gnome-build-meta.bst:oci/integration/boo.reason: GNOME OS image identity; Utah's base and build cover it

oci/os-release.bst.reason: Dakota's os-release; Utah's image writes its own

bluefin/brlaser.bst.reason: Dakota builds pdewacht/brlaser tag v6 (23117fe, 2019); Fedora and the factory build the maintained Owl-Maintain fork, v6.2.8, which continues it

bluefin/rpcbind.bst.reason: Fedora Rawhide ships 1.3.1; Dakota's anitya source pins 1.2.7

bluefin/tiptop.bst.reason: Dakota follows master at e91f7d6: the 2.3.2 release plus one upstream commit that shrinks an over-sized realloc in src/process.c (sizeof(struct process) to sizeof(struct process*)); no behaviour change

bluefin/umotd.bst.reason: Same projectbluefin/umotd upstream: Dakota installs the v0.3.3 release asset, while the factory repackages the v0.4.1 asset released 2026-10-25. Keep the newer release.

bluefin/uwelcome.bst.reason: Same projectbluefin/uwelcome upstream: Dakota installs the v0.4.1 release asset, while the factory repackages the v0.5.1 asset released 2026-11-09. Keep the newer release.

freedesktop-sdk.bst:components/_private/.reason: Dakota's 7.3 is the Linux kernel tag the element takes bpftool from; that kernel ships libbpf 1.8 and builds bpftool 7.8.0, so the factory's standalone bpftool 7.8.1 is the same release line, not five minors ahead.

Genuinely behind: Dakota's ncroxon/gnu-efi 4.0.4 is the same upstream as the factory's SourceForge 3.0.18, which Fedora Rawhide still ships. #1051 tracks the coordinated move and the rewrite of the SourceForge lock.

freedesktop-sdk.bst:components/dictionar.reason: another upstream: Fedora's hunspell-en builds the en-wl/wordlist (SCOWL) release 2026.02.25; Dakota's dictionaries.bst builds LibreOffice's dictionaries repository at libreoffice-26.8.2.2

freedesktop-sdk.bst:components/ffmpeg.bs.reason: Fedora Rawhide ships the 9.0 series (9.0.2); freedesktop-sdk 26.08 tracks n8.*

freedesktop-sdk.bst:components/foomatic-.reason: another version scheme: Fedora versions the database 4.0 and carries the snapshot date in the tarball (foomatic-db-4.0-20260511), newer than Dakota's master at 20240504 plus 10 commits

freedesktop-sdk.bst:components/frei0r.bs.reason: Both build dyne/frei0r; Dakota pins tag v3.6.0 while Fedora Rawhide and the factory ship 3.7.1.

freedesktop-sdk.bst:components/geoclue-l.reason: a filter of _private/geoclue-base.bst, which pins tag 2.8.2

freedesktop-sdk.bst:components/geoclue.b.reason: a filter of _private/geoclue-base.bst, which pins tag 2.8.2

freedesktop-sdk.bst:components/gflags.bs.reason: Genuinely behind: Dakota pins v2.3.1 while Fedora Rawhide and the factory are at 2.2.2. A 2.3.1 bump is held after a failed build (config/bump-holds.json, run 44765133559); #1051 tracks the move.

freedesktop-sdk.bst:components/glslang.b.reason: glslang tag 16.4.0 and vulkan-sdk-1.4.357.0 are the same commit (168d452); the factory's Source0 is that SDK tag, and the SBOM reads the SDK version

freedesktop-sdk.bst:components/grpc.bst.reason: Dakota pins grpc v1.84.1 while the factory recipe is at 1.75.1; the rebuild waits on the protobuf decision in #1136, because grpc cannot resolve python3dist(protobuf) >= 6.31.1 until that lands.

freedesktop-sdk.bst:components/lcms.bst.reason: Same Little-CMS upstream: Dakota pins tag 2.19.1 while the factory carries 2.20 from Fedora Rawhide via #1132. Keep the newer release.

freedesktop-sdk.bst:components/open-iscs.reason: Fedora's RPM Version prefixes upstream open-iscsi 2.1.13 with a legacy '6.'; both sides build the same tag 40f6b29, so 6.2.1.13 is not a newer release line than Dakota's 2.1.13.

freedesktop-sdk.bst:components/protobuf..reason: Hummingbird already ships protobuf 36.2; the factory's 33.6 recipe is pinned by libphonenumber (libprotobuf.so.33.6.0) and coupled to abseil-cpp and criu: retire the recipe or rebuild it at 36.2

freedesktop-sdk.bst:components/python3-g.reason: This element shares the grpc-source.yml pin of v1.84.1; the factory's 1.75.1 Python subpackages are blocked on the protobuf decision in #1136, which also decides whether python3-grpcio is built at all.

freedesktop-sdk.bst:components/squashfs-.reason: the factory carries 4.7.5 (Fedora Rawhide 4.7.4); Dakota pins 4.6.1

freedesktop-sdk.bst:components/wireless-.reason: Dakota's tag master-2023-09-01 reads as 2023.0.9; the factory's 2026.09.03 (Fedora Rawhide's) is three years newer

freedesktop-sdk.bst:components/xorg-font.reason: The RPM Version 7.5 is a frozen umbrella number, not a release line comparable to Dakota's font-util 1.4.2. The recipe's real source is font-util 1.4.1, so there is a genuine one-patch gap to 1.4.2, tracked in #1051.

freedesktop-sdk.bst:components/xwayland..reason: Fedora Rawhide ships the 26.1 release candidates (26.0.99.904); freedesktop-sdk 26.08 pins 24.1.14

gnome-build-meta.bst:core-deps/flatpak.b.reason: Fedora Rawhide ships the 1.19 series (1.19.2); gnome-build-meta pins the 1.18 stable series

gnome-build-meta.bst:core-deps/libplist..reason: The factory holds 2.7.0 because 2.8 moves libplist-2.0.so.4 to .so.12 and breaks gvfs-afc and the libimobiledevice stack (#1227); #1231 records the hold and the coordinated move with consumers.

gnome-build-meta.bst:core-deps/libtatsu..reason: the factory carries 1.1.1 (Fedora Rawhide 1.0.5); gnome-build-meta pins 1.0.5

gnome-build-meta.bst:core-deps/slirp-hel.reason: slirp-helper builds the libslirp Rust crate 4.3.2 (bindings plus the helper binary), not the C library; freedesktop-sdk's libslirp.bst, the C library, is 4.9.6 like the factory

gnome-build-meta.bst:freedesktop-sdk-ext.reason: the factory carries 1.57.0 (Fedora Rawhide 1.59.0); freedesktop-sdk-extra pins 1.52.0
another upstream: Fedora's words is the mwords list 3.0 (/usr/share/dict/words); Dakota's words.bst builds it from aspell dictionaries (aspell6-en 2020.12.07 and others)

gnome-build-meta.bst:gnomeos-deps/therma.reason: gnome-build-meta's ref reads v2.15.10, but its commit 88369b4 is intel/thermal_daemon tag v2.5.10; the factory's 2.5.13 (Fedora Rawhide's) is newer

gnome-build-meta.bst:gnomeos-deps/vpnc.b.reason: Dakota's commit d0fd23d (2024-02-26) is an ancestor of the factory's snapshot 11e15a1 (2024-11-13, Fedora Rawhide's)
